ONE, TWO OR THREE? Austin rent check.

Zumper’s Austin bedroom-count table lists average monthly rents of:
• 1 bedroom: $1,350
• 2 bedrooms: $1,691
• 3 bedrooms: $2,200

These figures reflect different groups of listings across property types in Zumper’s rolling 30-day sample. They provide a starting point for comparing layouts, rather than a quote for a particular home or a measure of signed leases.

For Austin renters, compare the full monthly cost: required fees, utilities, parking, lease length and how any concession is applied. Owners should compare similar homes nearby before setting an asking rent.

Source: Zumper Austin rent research, page updated November 16, 2026; checked November 17.
